TRANSLATION STATUS 0.1

A working beginning.

This is a native browser rewrite in progress. It is not yet the complete game or a verified 1:1 recreation.

  • Original world assetsMaps, tiles, character sprites, Pokémon sprites, base stats, moves, encounters, trainer parties.
  • Playable openingHome → Oak’s lab → rival → parcel → Viridian Forest → Brock. Event sequences are abbreviated.
  • Browser systemsMovement, collisions, map transitions, dialogue, basic battles, capture, party, healing, shops, saving, data editing.
  • Still to translateLater story scripts, all badges and the League, complete move effects, evolution flow, HMs, inventory breadth, original music, NPC schedules, link battles, and timing / bug parity.

Battle RNG uses a seeded JavaScript generator. Capture, trainer AI, experience sharing, move replacement, and some battle rules are simplified. A matching-data count does not mean matching gameplay.

FIELD GUIDE

Welcome back to Kanto.

Use the arrow keys or WASD to move. Press Z, Enter, or the A button to talk, read signs, and advance dialogue. X or B goes back. Escape opens the game menu.

  1. Go downstairs and leave your house. Walk north toward Route 1 to meet Oak.
  2. Choose a Poké Ball in the lab. Your rival challenges you as you leave.
  3. Walk north to Viridian City. Visit the Mart to collect Oak’s parcel, then bring it back to the lab.
  4. Buy Poké Balls and potions. Train on Route 1, heal at Pokémon Centers, and head through Viridian Forest toward Pewter.
  5. Challenge Brock in Pewter Gym. That’s the end of the current story implementation.

Use the Workbench to inspect the rest of the original world or change a Pokémon’s data. Build notes describe what is and isn’t implemented.
